articles.title: England await Guehi scan results after injury concern
articles.summary: Manchester City defender Marc Guehi will undergo a scan on a hip complaint on Sunday to determine whether he can report for England duty this week.

articles.title: Last season difficult with injury and miscarriage - Muniz
articles.summary: Fulham striker Rodrigo Muniz, who scored for his side in a 1-1 draw against Newcastle United, speaks of the struggles he endured last season.

articles.title: Borthwick and Itoje reject reports of England squad rift - 'Not accurate'
articles.summary: England head coach Steve Borthwick and captain Maro Itoje have rejected claims made in a newspaper article this week of a squad rift, saying it "does not represent the environment" they recognise.&#16

articles.title: Australia reach World Cup final as Samoa fume at decisions
articles.summary: Australia are one win away from a record-extending 13th men's Rugby League World Cup title after beating Samoa 44-12 in a fractious clash to secure a showdown with New Zealand in next weekend's Brisba
